Quick reference

Course glossary

ALL

Returns all values or rows while removing filters for the specified object.

ALLSELECTED

Function retaining outer selections while removing row/column context.

AVERAGEX

Iterator that averages row-level expression results.

Absolute variance

Current value minus comparison value.

Acceptance criterion

Testable condition used to decide whether the project is complete.

Accumulating snapshot

Fact table that tracks milestones of a process in one row.

Active relationship

Default relationship used for filter propagation.

Additive measure

Measure that can be summed across all relevant dimensions.

Aggregation

Summary such as sum, count, minimum, or maximum.

Alt text

Text description of a visual for assistive technology.

Ambiguity

More than one valid filter path between model objects.

Analytical population

The records intended to be represented by the report.

App

Packaged distribution experience for a target audience.

App navigation

Organized links and sections shown to app users.

Append

Operation that stacks rows from multiple tables.

Applied step

One transformation in a Power Query pipeline.

Association table

Another name for a table storing many-to-many links.

Audience

Group receiving a defined subset of app content.

BLANK

Special DAX value representing no meaningful result.

Back button

Navigation control returning to the source page.

Base measure

Simple reusable measure used by other calculations.

Baseline

Starting value of a quantitative axis.

Bookmark

Saved report state.

Bookmark navigator

Visual control generated from bookmark groups.

Boolean filter

Simple column condition used as a CALCULATE filter.

Bridge table

Table that resolves associations between dimensions.

Business process

Event or activity measured by a fact table.

Button action

Navigation or interaction triggered by a button.

CALCULATE

Evaluates an expression under modified filter context.

COUNTROWS

Counts rows in a table expression.

Calculated column

Column calculated row by row and stored in the model.

Calendar context

Dates active in the current filter context.

Card

Visual emphasizing one or a few values.

Cardinality

Whether relationship keys are one or many on each side.

Categorical axis

Axis containing distinct labels.

Clean

Removes non-printing characters.

Close & Apply

Saves query changes and loads enabled queries into the model.

Color contrast

Difference in luminance needed for readability.

Column distribution

Frequency and distinctness summary for a column.

Column profile

Detailed statistics and value distribution.

Column pruning

Removing fields not required by the analytical model.

Column quality

Summary of valid, error, and empty values.

Column reference

Reference written as Table[Column].

Combo chart

Visual combining column and line series.

Comparable period

Period aligned by duration and business calendar.

Comparison

Evaluation of magnitude across categories.

Comparison set

Items against which the current item is ranked.

Conditional formatting

Formatting controlled by data or rules.

Connector

A component that defines how Power BI connects to a source.

Content ownership

Responsibility for maintaining and approving an item.

Context transition

Conversion of row context into filter context.

Continuous axis

Axis representing a numeric or date continuum.

Continuous date range

Sequence with no missing calendar dates.

Contribution

Share of a total attributable to an item.

Control count

A row count used to verify a transformation.

Credentials

Authentication information used to access a source.

Cross-filter

Interaction that removes unrelated data from another visual.

Cross-filter direction

Direction in which filters propagate.

Cross-highlight

Interaction that emphasizes selected contribution while retaining totals.

Cumulative scope

Date range included in accumulation.

Current row

Specific record being evaluated.

Custom column

Column created with an M expression.

Cutoff date

Latest date included in a period-to-date calculation.

DAX

Formula language for tabular semantic models.

DAX query

Statement that returns tabular results from a semantic model.

DAX query duration

Time spent evaluating the semantic-model query.

DISTINCTCOUNT

Counts distinct nonblank values plus a possible blank.

DIVIDE

DAX function for safe division with optional alternate result.

Dashboard

Single-page tile canvas in the Power BI service.

Data category

Metadata describing geographic, URL, image, or other semantic meaning.

Data classification

Assignment of handling requirements to information.

Data type

Rule defining how values are stored and interpreted.

Data view

View used to inspect loaded table data and calculations.

Date part

A component such as year, month, or weekday.

Date table

Dimension containing one unique row for every required date.

Default summarization

Default aggregation assigned to a numeric field.

Defensive calculation

Logic that handles invalid or undefined cases explicitly.

Degenerate dimension

Descriptive identifier stored directly in a fact table, such as an order number.

Delimiter

Character used to separate values.

Denominator

Value by which the numerator is divided.

Denominator scope

Filters retained or removed for the total.

Denormalization

Combining descriptive attributes into a dimension for usability.

Dense rank

Ranking method without gaps after ties.

Dependency graph

Visual map of query relationships.

Description

Metadata explaining the purpose and definition of an object.

Desktop

Power BI Desktop authoring application.

Desktop version

The specific Power BI Desktop build used to author a file.

Detail page

Page designed for one selected entity or category.

Diagnostic page

Page designed to investigate drivers and segments.

Dimension table

Table containing descriptive attributes used for filtering and grouping.

Direct Lake

Fabric storage mode that reads OneLake data with minimal copying.

DirectQuery

Keeps data in the source and sends queries when visuals are used.

Display folder

Organizational folder for model fields and measures.

Distribution

Pattern of values including center, spread, and unusual observations.

Drill down

Move to a lower hierarchy level for a selected item.

Drill up

Return to a higher hierarchy level.

Drillthrough

Navigation to a filtered detail page.

Drillthrough field

Field that carries context to the destination page.

Duplicate

Independent copy of a query’s existing steps.

Dynamic RLS

Security rule using user identity to determine allowed rows.

Dynamic title

Title generated from current filter context.

EVALUATE

DAX statement that returns a table expression.

Effective permission

Access a user actually receives after all roles and sharing paths.

Error value

A value that failed a transformation or conversion.

Executive page

Summary page for headline performance and decisions.

Expand

Operation that selects columns from a nested joined table.

Export data

Download of summarized or underlying visual data when permitted.

Expression

Combination of functions, operators, columns, and constants.

FILTER

Returns a filtered table.

Fact table

Table containing measurable events at a defined grain.

Field value formatting

Formatting driven by a measure or column containing style values.

Filter argument

Condition or table expression supplied to CALCULATE.

Filter context

Filters active when an expression is evaluated.

Filter propagation

Movement of filter context through model relationships.

Fiscal calendar

Organization-specific reporting calendar.

Fiscal period

Organization-defined accounting period.

Folder connector

Connector that combines files from a folder using a sample transformation.

Foreign key

Fact-table column referring to a dimension key.

Format string

Rule controlling how a value is displayed.

Formula bar

Area that displays the M expression for the selected step.

Function

Named operation that accepts arguments and returns a value or table.

Gateway

Software that securely connects cloud services to private data sources.

Governance

Policies and controls for reliable, secure, and accountable data use.

Grain

Exact meaning of one row.

Grand total

Total across the full allowed population.

Granularity

Level of detail represented by a visual cell or row.

Grid

Alignment structure used to organize page objects.

Grouping key

Field used to form groups.

Growth rate

Variance divided by the comparison value.

Hidden field

Model field unavailable to ordinary report authors.

Hierarchy

Ordered group of fields used for drill navigation.

Hierarchy level

One ordered field in a drill path.

Hover context

Filter context generated by the hovered data point.

Identifier

A code used to identify an entity and usually treated as text.

Import mode

Loads compressed data into the Power BI semantic model.

Imputation

Replacement of a missing value using a defined rule.

Inactive relationship

Relationship stored in the model but not used by default.

Incomplete window

Early period containing fewer observations than requested.

Information density

Amount of information presented in a limited area.

Insight narrative

Plain-language explanation connecting evidence, implication, limitation, and next action.

Interaction source

Visual from which a selection originates.

Interaction target

Visual affected by the selection.

Iterator

Function that evaluates an expression for each row of a table.

Join kind

Rule deciding which matched and unmatched rows are retained.

KEEPFILTERS

Adds a filter without replacing existing filters on the same columns.

KPI status

Categorical interpretation based on documented thresholds.

Least privilege

Granting only the access required.

Live connection

Connects a report to an existing semantic model or Analysis Services model.

Load

Loads selected source objects using their current shape.

Locale

Regional convention used to parse dates, numbers, and text.

Long format

Structure with one measure column and attributes in rows.

M

Functional language used by Power Query.

MTD

Month-to-date accumulation.

Maintenance

Ongoing refresh, monitoring, documentation, and controlled change.

Many-to-many

Relationship where keys repeat on both sides.

Matrix visual

Pivot-style visual with grouped rows and columns.

Maximum date

Latest date represented by the current visual point.

Measure

Calculation evaluated in the current filter context.

Measure reference

Reference written as [Measure].

Merge

Power Query operation that joins tables.

Merge columns

Operation that combines fields into one text value.

Metadata

Names, descriptions, formats, folders, and properties that explain model objects.

Metric definition

A documented rule describing how a measure is calculated.

Metric dictionary

Documented definitions for measures and business rules.

Microsoft Fabric

Microsoft’s integrated analytics platform that includes Power BI experiences.

Microsoft Store version

Installation channel that updates automatically.

Mobile app

Application for viewing and interacting with reports on mobile devices.

Model usability

Ease with which users can create correct analyses.

Model view

View used to inspect and manage model tables, relationships, and metadata.

Moving average

Average calculated over a rolling window.

My workspace

Personal workspace not intended for governed team delivery.

Native query

Query executed by the source system.

Navigator

Window used to select source objects for loading or transformation.

Non-color cue

Text, icon, shape, or pattern that communicates meaning without color alone.

Null

A missing or unknown value.

Object-level security

Security that hides model tables or columns.

Operator

Symbol that performs arithmetic, comparison, or logical work.

Optimization

Evidence-based improvement of model, measure, or report performance.

PBIX

Power BI Desktop project file format.

Page-level filter

Filter applied to all visuals on one page.

Parameter

Named value used to control a query.

Performance Analyzer

Power BI Desktop tool that records visual performance.

Periodic snapshot

Fact table with one row per entity per regular period.

Pivot

Transforms row values into columns.

Power BI Desktop

The Windows authoring application used to connect, transform, model, and design reports.

Power BI service

The online service used to publish, share, refresh, and govern Power BI content.

Power Query Editor

Separate editor used to connect, profile, and transform data before loading.

Pre-aggregation

Summarization before loading into the model.

Preview

A limited view of source values used before loading.

Preview feature

A feature available for testing before general availability.

Prior period

Comparable period before the current one.

Privacy level

Classification controlling how data sources may be combined.

Profiling scope

Whether profiling uses a sample or the entire dataset.

Project brief

Document defining purpose, audience, questions, scope, and deliverables.

Publish

Upload Power BI content from Desktop to the service.

QTD

Quarter-to-date accumulation.

Quality assurance

Structured verification that a report meets requirements.

Quality flag

A field recording whether a row passed a data-quality rule.

Query

A repeatable data connection and transformation definition.

Query folding

Translation of Power Query steps into source-native operations.

Query time

Time when measures are evaluated for report interactions.

Query view

Power BI Desktop view for authoring and testing DAX queries.

RANKX

Iterator that ranks rows by an expression.

RELATED

Function that retrieves a value from a related one-side table in row context.

REMOVEFILTERS

Clears filters from specified tables or columns.

RETURN

Keyword returning the final expression.

Reference

New query that starts from another query result.

Refresh

Re-execution of source connections and transformation steps.

Refresh history

Record of refresh outcomes and errors.

Refresh time

Time when imported data and calculated columns are processed.

Regression test

Test confirming an existing behavior still works after change.

Relationship path

Sequence through which filters travel between tables.

Release cadence

The regular schedule on which Power BI Desktop is updated.

Release evidence

Screenshots, totals, logs, and approvals supporting publication.

Report

One or more interactive pages built from a semantic model.

Report item

Published report connected to a semantic model.

Report page tooltip

Custom report page used as a tooltip.

Report view

View used to design report pages and visuals.

Report-level filter

Filter applied across all report pages.

Requirement

A defined business need the report must support.

Role

Named set of model filter rules.

Role-playing dimension

One dimension used in multiple semantic roles, such as Order Date and Ship Date.

Rolling window

Period that moves with the current date.

Row context

Current row available during row-by-row evaluation.

Row filter

Rule that keeps or removes records.

Row-level security

Model rules restricting rows visible to a user.

Running total

Cumulative value through the current point.

SUMMARIZECOLUMNS

Function used to group and calculate query results.

SUMX

Iterator that sums row-level expression results.

Sample file

File used to define transformation logic for a folder import.

Scalar variable

Variable containing one value.

Scatter plot

Visual showing paired quantitative values.

Scheduled refresh

Service process that reloads imported data on a schedule.

Schema consistency

Agreement of column structure across appended sources.

Schema drift

Unexpected change in source columns or data types over time.

Secondary axis

Additional quantitative scale that requires careful interpretation.

Selected total

Total within current outer selections.

Selection pane

Pane controlling object visibility and layering.

Semantic model

A governed analytical layer containing tables, relationships, calculations, and metadata.

Semantic model item

Published model used by reports.

Sensitivity label

Information-protection classification applied to content.

Service

Cloud service for publishing and collaboration.

Slicer

Interactive control that adds filters.

Small multiple

Repeated visual panels using a shared scale and design.

Smoothing

Reduction of short-term variation to reveal a trend.

Snowflake schema

Model where dimensions are normalized into related subdimensions.

Sort by column

Property used to order labels by another column.

Source metadata

Information such as filename and folder path retained for auditing.

Split column

Operation that divides one field into multiple fields.

Staging query

Intermediate query used to centralize source and cleaning logic.

Star schema

Dimensional model with facts connected directly to dimensions.

Status rule

Documented mapping from metric values to labels or colors.

Subscription

Scheduled delivery of report snapshots or links.

Subtotal

Summary value for a group in a matrix.

Surrogate key

Model-controlled key used to identify a dimension row.

Tab order

Sequence in which keyboard focus moves through objects.

Table expression

Expression that returns a table for an iterator or filter.

Table function

M function that transforms or creates tables.

Table grain

Meaning of one row after grouping.

Table variable

Variable containing a table expression.

Table visual

Flat rows and columns.

Target fact

Table containing planned values at a defined grain.

Target grain

Dimensions and period represented by one target row.

Tenant setting

Organization-level Power BI configuration managed by administrators.

Test as role

Desktop feature for validating security behavior.

Time intelligence

Calculations comparing values across defined time periods.

Tooltip

Context shown on hover.

Tooltip field

Field that helps determine when a tooltip is relevant.

Top N

Selection of the highest N items by a measure.

Transaction fact

Fact table with one row per event.

Transform Data

Opens selected objects in Power Query Editor.

Transformation layer

The stage where data shape and source-level values are prepared.

Trend

Change over an ordered time axis.

Trim

Removes leading and trailing spaces.

Type conversion error

A value that cannot be converted to the requested type.

USERELATIONSHIP

DAX function that activates a relationship for one calculation.

Unmatched row

A source row with no key match in the other table.

Unpivot

Transforms columns into attribute-value rows.

Update app

Action that publishes workspace changes to app users.

User acceptance test

Business-user validation against expected use cases.

VAR

Keyword defining a DAX variable.

Validation

Evidence that data, model, measures, and visuals behave as intended.

Variance

Actual value minus target or comparison value.

Visual context

Context created by fields placed in a visual.

Visual display

Time spent rendering the visual.

Visual encoding

Use of position, length, color, shape, or size to represent data.

Visual hierarchy

Order in which a page directs attention.

Visual-level filter

Filter applied to one visual.

Waterfall chart

Visual showing positive and negative contributions to a total.

White space

Intentional empty space that separates and groups content.

Wide format

Structure with repeated measures across multiple columns.

Wireframe

Low-fidelity layout plan for a report page.

Workspace

Collaborative container for Power BI items.

Workspace role

Permission level for collaborating in a workspace.

YTD

Year-to-date accumulation.

in expression

Expression that returns the final result.

let expression

Block that defines named values or steps.
